case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

sup:DEMO-J1.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
sup:DEMO-J1.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We thank you for your alternative proposals, but must point out that DAP delivery and a 35-day lead time introduce significant additional freight and production costs. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €17.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. To support your budget, we have reduced our price to €15.50 per unit, based on our original EXW and 45-day lead time terms, which is a package at a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW at standard terms. 

Should DAP delivery be a strict requirement, we would be glad to calculate a dedicated price including the necessary freight charges. Please note our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
